== Biography ==
{{Ireland Native}}
Mary was born about 1842. She was the daughter of David Glasgow, Farmer, Killycurragh.<ref name="mar"/>

On 29 Mar 1859, at Oritor Presbyterian, Kildress, she married David Glasgow, farmer of Killycurragh, son of James Glasgow. She was 16.
<ref name="mar">[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/907b423288153 David Glasgow, Mary Glasgow, 29 Mar 1859, Cookstown] at Irish Civil Registration - Births</ref>

As of 1911 she lived with son Samuel and his wife Annabella in Ballynagilly.<ref>[http://www.census.nationalarchives.ie/pages/1911/Tyrone/Lissan/Ballynagilly/858935/ 1911 Ireland census] - Residents of a house 31 in Ballynagilly (Lissan, Tyrone). Mary(68), Samuel(38).
</ref>

She passed away 26 Feb 1917 age 74 at Ballynagilly due to heart disease. Attended by son Samuel.
<ref>[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/e4d3223637345 Mary Glasgow, 1917, Cookstown] at Irish Civil Registration - Deaths</ref>
She is buried at Cookstown cemetery.
<ref>[[Space:Forthill_Cemetery%2C_Cookstown%2C_Tyrone|Forthill Cemetery, Cookstown, Tyrone]] - OP/A/287</ref>
